issues.description: Method 'toString' in class de.tum.cit.ase.Lecture has inconsistent return types across artifacts. The problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 36-38) requires a custom toString() method (by convention and example it should return a String). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 64) the method is declared as 'public Object toString()' and annotated with @Override. java.lang.Object.toString() has the signature 'public String toString()', so declaring 'public Object toString()' does not match and the @Override annotation will cause a compile-time error. This contradicts the exercise requirement and produces a non-compilable reference solution, which will confuse or block students.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java change the method signature to 'public String toString()' so it correctly overrides java.lang.Object.toString() and matches the problem statement. Keep the @Override annotation and return the current concatenated String expression. Rebuild to verify the solution compiles and the reference implementation matches the exercise description.
